notes: This is a competitor arm (Anthropic docx skill, docx-js). The docx-cli reader shows the footer as 'Page  of' because docx-js writes fldChar/instrText in the same run as the literal text and docx-cli does not turn that shape into {page}/{pages} tokens. That is a docx-cli reader gap. Word renders 'Page X of Y' correctly, so it does not count against the competitor. The --ast .sections jq path returned nothing, so section structure was taken from the read view's docx:section notes and the render.
weakAgentStruggle: Moderate. The agent got there, but SKILL.md gave no recipe for SVG images (it had to find rsvg-convert itself and add a PNG fallback), multi-column sections, footnotes, hyperlinks or PAGE fields, so it wrote them from memory of the docx-js API. validate.py failed under python3 -I ('No module named helpers'). Its first build dropped 'in the' from the colophon, which only a render caught. The output is correct, but the path depended on the agent's own knowledge of the API, not the skill's guidance.
